en: Movement diagrams · match the labeled hand to your own hand. Your camera view is mirrored.
zh: 动作图示 · 请将图中标注的手对应到你自己的同侧手。摄像头画面是镜像的。

en: First, set up
zh: 首先，完成设置

en: Pause & finish
zh: 暂停与结束

en: Camera starts only when you enable it inside the game. Gameplay and camera replay stay on this device unless you choose to share.
zh: 只有在游戏内开启摄像头后，它才会启动。游戏内容和摄像头回放会保留在此设备上，除非你主动选择分享。

en: Keep the ball in play and clear the bricks.
zh: 接住球，让它持续反弹并清除砖块。

en: Move the paddle
zh: 移动挡板

en: Shift your whole torso left or right. The paddle follows the direction you see in the mirrored camera.
zh: 整个躯干向左或向右移动。挡板会跟随你在镜像摄像头画面中看到的方向。

en: Meet the ball
zh: 接住球

en: Move under the falling ball to bounce it back toward the bricks. No raised-hand action is needed.
zh: 移动到下落的球下方，把它弹回砖块方向。不需要举手。

en: Keep returning the ball, or choose Finish round to save your replay.
zh: 继续把球弹回去，或选择“结束本轮”来保存回放。

en: Return the ball
zh: 把球弹回去

en: Shoot the invaders before they reach your ship.
zh: 在入侵者抵达飞船前将它们击落。

en: Steer your ship
zh: 操控飞船

en: Shift your torso left or right to line up with an invader and avoid incoming shots.
zh: 躯干向左或向右移动，对准入侵者并躲避来袭火力。

en: Fire once
zh: 开火一次

en: Fire again
zh: 再次开火

en: Lower your left hand fully, then raise it again for the next shot. Keep your right hand down while firing.
zh: 将左手完全放下，再次举起以发射下一发。开火时保持右手放下。

en: Steer with your torso
zh: 用躯干转向

en: Build a tower by dropping each moving slab onto the one below.
zh: 将每个移动方块落在下方方块上，搭起高塔。

en: Watch the moving slab
zh: 观察移动方块

en: Keep your body centered and your left hand lowered while the slab slides sideways.
zh: 方块左右移动时，身体保持居中，左手保持放下。

en: Choose the moment
zh: 把握时机

en: Raise your left hand as the slab lines up with the tower. Your movement takes a short moment to register, so watch the timing.
zh: 方块与高塔对齐时举起左手。动作识别需要一点时间，请留意时机。

en: Reset for the next slab
zh: 为下一个方块复位

en: Raise your left wrist above your left shoulder, then lower it below your shoulder before the next action. Holding it up triggers only once. A missed landing ends the round.
zh: 将左手腕举过左肩，然后在下一次动作前放到肩膀下方。持续举手只会触发一次。方块落空会结束本轮。

en: Watch the alignment
zh: 观察对齐位置

en: Stack the next slab
zh: 堆叠下一个方块

en: Throw knives into clear spaces on the rotating target.
zh: 把飞刀投向旋转靶上的空位。

en: Watch the rotation
zh: 观察旋转

en: Keep your left hand down and wait for a gap between the knives already in the target.
zh: 保持左手放下，等待靶上已有飞刀之间出现空隙。

en: Throw into a gap
zh: 投向空隙

en: Avoid existing knives
zh: 避开已有飞刀

en: Time the next raise for another clear space. A knife hitting another knife ends the round.
zh: 看准下一个空位再次举手。飞刀撞上另一把飞刀会结束本轮。

en: Wait for a gap
zh: 等待空隙

en: Hit a clear space
zh: 命中空位

en: Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them.
zh: 连成三个或更多同色泡泡来消除它们。

en: Aim with your right wrist
zh: 用右手腕瞄准

en: Move your right wrist left, right, up or down while keeping it below shoulder height. Follow the on-screen aiming line.
zh: 保持右手腕低于肩膀，上下左右移动，并沿着屏幕上的瞄准线瞄准。

en: Shoot with your left hand
zh: 用左手发射

en: Raise your left wrist above your left shoulder, then lower it below your shoulder before the next action. Holding it up triggers only once. Keep your right wrist below your shoulder while shooting.
zh: 将左手腕举过左肩，然后在下一次动作前放到肩膀下方。持续举手只会触发一次。发射时保持右手腕低于肩膀。

en: Match colors
zh: 匹配颜色

en: Aim toward matching bubbles, lower your left hand, then raise it again for the next shot. Raising both hands is reserved for pause.
zh: 瞄准同色泡泡，放下左手，再次举起以发射下一发。举起双手专用于暂停。

en: Match the colors
zh: 匹配颜色

en: Drop matching fruit together to merge them into larger fruit.
zh: 让相同水果落在一起，合成更大的水果。

en: Choose a drop position
zh: 选择落点

en: Shift your torso left or right. The held fruit follows your movement across the container.
zh: 躯干向左或向右移动，待投放的水果会跟随你在容器上方移动。

en: Release the fruit
zh: 投放水果

en: Plan the next drop
zh: 规划下一次投放

en: Let the fruit settle and place matching fruit together. Keep the pile below the top boundary.
zh: 等待水果稳定，再把相同水果放在一起。不要让水果堆超过顶部边界。

en: Choose a position
zh: 选择位置

en: Merge matching fruit
zh: 合成相同水果

en: Use the game’s Stop control to end camera play. If tracking is lost, return to view before continuing.
zh: 使用游戏中的“停止”控制结束摄像头游戏。如果动作跟踪丢失，请回到画面中再继续。

en: Bend your knees into a comfortable squat. Watch the charge indicator fill.
zh: 屈膝下蹲到舒适位置，观察蓄力指示器逐渐填满。

en: Cast the spell
zh: 施放法术

en: Stand upright again to complete the action and attack. Staying crouched does not score another repetition.
zh: 重新站直以完成动作并攻击。持续蹲着不会再计一次。

en: Return to standing between repetitions. The round ends after five completed actions.
zh: 每次动作之间都要恢复站立。完成五次动作后，本轮结束。

en: Stand to calibrate
zh: 站立校准

en: Position your camera so your head and at least one shoulder are visible in a comfortable push-up position. Enable the camera and hold in view for the automatic countdown.
zh: 调整摄像头，让你以舒适的俯卧撑姿势时，头部和至少一侧肩膀保持可见。开启摄像头并保持入镜，倒计时会自动开始。

en: Use Finish & rest to end a flight. The camera stops if the page is hidden or loses focus.
zh: 使用“结束并休息”结束飞行。如果页面被隐藏或失去焦点，摄像头会停止。

en: Move your head
zh: 移动头部

en: The helicopter follows your head in the mirrored camera: move up, down or sideways to steer.
zh: 直升机会跟随镜像摄像头画面中的头部；上下或左右移动来操控方向。

en: Pass through the gates
zh: 穿过障碍门

en: Lower and push up at your own pace to line up with the next opening. Gate opening and speed can be adjusted in the game.
zh: 按自己的节奏降低再撑起，对准下一个开口。你可以在游戏中调整开口大小和速度。

en: Finish and rest
zh: 结束并休息

en: Choose Finish & rest when you want to stop. Try a demo uses pointer or arrow-key controls without a camera.
zh: 想停止时选择“结束并休息”。“试玩演示”使用指针或方向键控制，无需摄像头。

en: Head + shoulder visible
zh: 头部 + 一侧肩膀可见

en: Fly through gates
zh: 飞过障碍门

en: Raise and return your body to help Dino clear the cacti.
zh: 抬高身体再回到原位，帮助 Dino 越过仙人掌。

en: Stand still while your movement range is set automatically, then raise your LEFT hand for one second. No calibration jump is required.
zh: 站稳，让系统自动设置动作范围，然后举起左手并保持一秒。不需要校准跳跃。

en: Raise your body as a cactus approaches, then return to your standing position. Dino turns the detected rise and return into a jump.
zh: 仙人掌靠近时抬高身体，然后回到站立位置。Dino 会把检测到的上升和回落转成一次跳跃。

en: Return to your baseline before the next movement. Keep your shoulders and hips visible.
zh: 下一次动作前回到基准位置，并让肩膀和髋部保持可见。

en: Set your standing pose
zh: 设置站立姿势

en: Help Dino jump over the cacti.
zh: 帮助 Dino 跳过仙人掌。

en: Enable the camera, calibrate standing and a comfortable jump range, then raise one hand for one second to confirm. Lower both hands before the countdown.
zh: 开启摄像头，校准站立姿势和舒适的跳跃范围，然后举起一只手并保持一秒来确认。倒计时前放下双手。

en: Calibrate first
zh: 先完成校准

en: Keep your shoulders and hips visible and follow the standing and jump-range prompts.
zh: 让肩膀和髋部保持可见，并按照站立和跳跃范围提示操作。

en: Lift Dino
zh: 让 Dino 升高

en: Raise your torso to lift Dino. Your return toward standing brings Dino back down.
zh: 抬高躯干让 Dino 升高。回到站立姿势时，Dino 会随之落下。

en: Time the next rise
zh: 把握下一次上升时机

en: Return to your standing baseline between obstacles. The displayed height is relative to your own calibration.
zh: 在障碍之间回到站立基准。显示的高度以你自己的校准结果为基准。

en: Calibrate standing
zh: 校准站立姿势

en: Raise your torso
zh: 抬高躯干

en: Jump Dino through the obstacles over your live camera view.
zh: 在实时摄像头画面中，让 Dino 跳过障碍。

en: Choose camera play, keep your shoulders and hips visible, and follow the standing calibration prompts. When ready, raise both hands above your shoulders for one second, then lower them to start.
zh: 选择摄像头模式，让肩膀和髋部保持可见，并按照站立校准提示操作。准备好后，将双手举过肩膀并保持一秒，再放下双手开始。

en: Start from a steady standing pose so the game can measure relative body movement.
zh: 先保持稳定站立，让游戏测量身体的相对动作。

en: Raise your body
zh: 抬高身体

en: Lift your shoulders and torso as a cactus approaches. Watch Dino rise over the camera view.
zh: 仙人掌靠近时抬高肩膀和躯干，观察 Dino 在摄像头画面中升起。

en: Return to standing
zh: 恢复站立

en: Settle back to your standing baseline before the next movement.
zh: 下一次动作前稳定回到站立基准。

en: Lift your shoulders
zh: 抬高肩膀

en: Jump through your room
zh: 在房间中跳跃

en: Tap ten moving stars in this concept preview.
zh: 在概念预览中点击十个移动的星星。

en: This preview uses pointer or touch input. It does not recognize body movements or open your camera.
zh: 此预览使用指针或触控输入，不识别身体动作，也不会开启摄像头。

en: Find the star
zh: 找到星星

en: Look for the star in the play area.
zh: 在游戏区域中寻找星星。

en: Tap or click
zh: 轻触或点击

en: Select the star with your finger or pointer. It moves after each hit.
zh: 用手指或指针选择星星。每次点中后，它都会移动。

en: Reach ten hits
zh: 点中十次

en: Continue until the counter reaches ten, then start again.
zh: 继续操作，直到计数达到十，然后重新开始。

en: Use touch or pointer
zh: 使用触控或指针

en: Tap the star
zh: 点击星星
